title: Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model unlearning aims to remove the influence of designated training data while preserving unrelated model capabilities. Existing likelihood-based methods commonly optimize against fixed forget sequences, providing only negative supervision on what the model should not generate and overlooking the states visited by the evolving unlearned policy. We introduce Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation (CPSD), a new unlearning framework that constructs an explicit knowledge-reduced target distribution and distills it along the model's own trajectories. Given a student rollout, a frozen reference model evaluates each token under a plain context and a privileged context containing the forget information. CPSD treats the resulting distributional shift as a knowledge-associated direction and reverses it to obtain a counterfactual unlearning target. translated_title: 面向大语言模型遗忘的对比式在策自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 大语言模型遗忘旨在移除指定训练数据对模型的影响，同时保留无关的模型能力。现有的基于似然的方法通常针对固定的遗忘序列进行优化，仅对模型不应生成的内容提供负向监督，而忽略了不断演化的遗忘策略所经过的状态。我们提出了对比式在策自蒸馏（CPSD），这是一种新的遗忘框架，它构建一个显式的知识缩减目标分布，并沿模型自身的轨迹对其进行蒸馏。给定学生模型的一次 rollout，冻结的参考模型分别在普通上下文和包含遗忘信息的特权上下文下评估每个 token。CPSD 将由此产生的分布偏移视为与知识关联的方向，并将其反转以获得反事实遗忘目标。随后训练学生模型在每个 rollout 位置匹配该目标，同时保留无关能力（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出CPSD框架，通过构建显式的知识缩减目标分布，并沿模型自身的在策轨迹进行对比自蒸馏，实现大语言模型在遗忘指定数据的同时保留无关能力。
en_tdlr: CPSD introduces a contrastive on-policy self-distillation framework that constructs an explicit knowledge-reduced target distribution and distills it along the model's own trajectories, enabling LLM unlearning while preserving unrelated capabilities.
